x: Nowak as Vice-Captain, and with the assistance of enthusiasts like Clemens, Powell, Holder, Henchoz, Ivall, Kelly, Ellis, and others; and the addition of some newcomers, we may be certain that the Field Events men will contribute their share towards the progress the Club continues to make.
In the Long Jump, John Mitchell was forced to take 2nd place behind Kelly (HHH) with Bob Couillaut 4th and Barry Townsend 6th, only 1'7" covering the first six competitors.
Kelly of Herne Hill H., who won, was a couple of feet short of his normal distance so our boys, jumping close to their best should be well pleased.

What kind of decorated hot-rod for Datona or Southend beach and what about MacLennon, Mead and Kelly, our redoubtable Keystone boys? Difficulty arises with Thresher who has a Morris Cowley for his home in Ewell but dreams of a 2.4 Jaguar Coupé for his pad in Chelsea.

We already knew about Kelly Diprose, having seen him in action in the North Surrey League and in the Dudley to Bridgenorth relay earlier, but we knew little or nothing about Bob Smith who is in this country for a time as a dentist in Croydon.

We were still missing Vicki and Kelly in the throws but nonetheless covered all the events with a combination of Ann Walters tripling up on the shot, discus and javelin, Angela Weah's return to the field since becoming a mum, Tania having a go at the javelin, and Cynthia in the hammer.
For the first time this season both Vicki Hassell and Kelly Mellis were available to throw. Vicki covered the Hammer and Javelin and Kelly the Shot and Discus.
